acceptance_criteria.condition: The cleanup corpus, old Skill snapshot, prompts, runner, scorer, analyzer, generator, auditor, and wrapper are hash-frozen before any model trial.
A planned preregistration is analyzable as not_run and does not masquerade as model evidence.

invariants: The only planned condition difference is no_skill versus the frozen old/new Skill snapshots.
References and hidden tests remain unavailable to repair agents.
A planned record produces unknown/not_run and cannot support an improvement claim.

evidence: preregistration hash and planned analyzer output

confirmed_current: preregistration is generated before first trial
documentation_synchronization.evidence: README and protocol reference describe the cleanup profile.

instrumentation.reason: This commit freezes experiment inputs; no runtime boundary is changed.

safeguards.name: pre-registration envelope
safeguards.rationale: Manifest, prompts, Skill snapshots, runner, scorer, and analyzer hashes are frozen before trials.

design_boundary.rationale: The generated preregistration owns the experiment envelope; the analyzer owns interpretation.

data_ownership.rationale: Raw experiment artifacts remain append-only and condition labels stay in the preregistration record.

error_model.rationale: Planned, interrupted, and completed states are distinct; missing trials are ineligible.

contract_evolution.rationale: The existing V9 protocol is reused with a cleanup-profile manifest.

threat_boundary.rationale: References and hidden tests are not listed as Agent inputs.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The preregistration is committed before collection.

configuration_secrets.rationale: Authentication mode is recorded without credentials or tokens.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The protocol reference documents the frozen cleanup profile and limitations.

reproducibility.rationale: All declared inputs have SHA-256 identities and a deterministic task order.

verification.result: Planned experiment returned decision not_run and causal_conclusion unknown.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Planned preregistration is explicitly not model evidence.

remaining_risks: No paired model trials have completed; no Skill effect claim is supported.
The frozen Codex authentication mode may block collection and must be recorded rather than retried selectively.
